name: Cully

characteristics.housing_stock: Mix of 1940s-1950s ranches, some postwar bungalows, increasing new construction and ADUs
characteristics.transit_access: Moderate — frequent bus on 42nd and Cully Blvd, no MAX but planned improvements
characteristics.development_pipeline: Cully Main Street Plan investment, Living Cully community development projects, new affordable housing on 42nd

investment_thesis: Most diverse neighborhood in Portland with strong community investment through Living Cully coalition. Historically underinvested — meaning deferred maintenance and lower prices create rehab opportunity. Larger lot sizes support ADU additions. Rising steadily without the rapid gentrification pressure seen in closer-in neighborhoods. Good upside with lower displacement risk due to community land trust presence.
risk_factors: Limited transit connectivity compared to inner neighborhoods
Some areas lack sidewalks and urban infrastructure
Environmental justice concerns — legacy industrial contamination in spots
Fewer commercial amenities than competing neighborhoods
Community pushback on rapid development — need culturally sensitive approach
data_sources: Synthetic MLS data based on market knowledge
